what_is_proven: All 19 named imports bind with zero unresolved, Chocolate Doom boots and renders non-blank frames from a legally redistributable Freedoom WAD.
what_is_not_proven: No original-Windows gameplay oracle comparison was performed; this is not a claim of gameplay equivalence or Windows parity.

wad.name: freedoom1.wad (copied as doom.wad)
wad.licence: Freedoom is a freely redistributable Doom data replacement; no copyrighted DOOM.WAD was used.

rebuild.command: python3 -m tools.autorecomp chocolate-doom.exe --project-dir <dir> --assets-dir <game folder> --input-os windows --input-arch x86 --target-os host --target-arch host --out-mode full

stages.verify: ok (partial: process launched and exited 255; no oracle supplied)

run.exit_reason: guest engine reported R_DrawPlanes visplane overflow (43) after rendering; not an unresolved-import failure

limits: A hash proves byte identity only, not Windows or gameplay equivalence.
Exit 255 is an engine visplane-overflow error after rendering, not a binding failure; it is recorded honestly.
The selftest suite timed out as a whole on this host but api_gap_selftest.c completed with status ok; no other suite result is claimed here.
Frame colour counts are computed from committed BMP bytes by tools/frame_proof.py and re-verified by tests/test_issue28_proof.py.
